capabilities: Record microphone and system audio on desktop or microphone on mobile
Transcribe recordings live, after the meeting, or both, with speaker separation where supported
Generate AI-organized notes from built-in or custom templates with a mind-map overview
Extract people, todos, learning cards and hotwords into Markdown topic pages
Import audio, MP4 recordings and text transcripts, and export HTML, PDF or email reports
extras: Proprietary license since 2.2.0: source code is no longer publicly released and redistribution or repackaging is prohibited; earlier MIT-licensed releases keep their rights. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Detailed usage and troubleshooting live in an external user manual.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record meetings and turn recordings into structured notes, so users must juggle separate transcription and summarizing tools.

relations.evidence: The HTML slide-deck feature in earlier versions was inspired by alchaincyf/huashu-design
SiliconFlow, Alibaba Cloud Bailian, OpenAI, Xiaomi MiMo

requires.name: speech-to-text and AI service keys (SiliconFlow, OpenAI, DeepSeek, etc.)
virtual audio device (BlackHole, VB-Cable) for system audio on macOS/Linux

summary: Meeting recorder that captures audio, transcribes it live or afterward, and generates AI-organized Markdown notes, mind-map overviews and reports in the vault.
